correctness.rationale: For a uniformly random perfect matching of even N≥6 and its fixed-point-free involution π, condition on X_ab=1 and use a uniform residual matching of N-2 labels. Nonincident adjacent positions have descent probability p0=(N-2)/(2(N-3)); four (or three for adjacent endpoints) incident positions have the stated partner-count probabilities. Summing them yields six exhaustive cases of H_ab=(N-1)Cov(X_ab,D), including H_1N=1, corner zeros, interior short-chord (N-2)/(2(N-3)) and nonadjacent interior -1/(N-3). Exact sum over short chords yields Cov(S,D)=(N-2)/(2(N-1)), ES=1, Var(S)=(N-2)/(N-1). An independently written exhaustive perfect-matching generator checked every prescribed chord for N=6,8,10,12 (15,105,945,10395 matchings), matching conditional averages exactly. Combinatorial conditional proof covers all even N; finite search alone is not the proof.
